Despite Strasbourg's four-game unbeaten streak in their recent visits to the Stade Vélodrome, Marseille's squad depth, pre-season momentum, and strong home advantage give them the definitive edge on opening day.

The home advantage at the Stade Vélodrome is significant. However, Strasbourg has a notable recent head-to-head record, being unbeaten in their last four visits to Marseille. This history of securing draws tempers confidence slightly. Despite this, Strasbourg's very poor pre-season form contrasts sharply with Marseille's, making a home win the most probable outcome for the first match of the season.

While Strasbourg has a surprisingly good recent record at Stade Vélodrome (unbeaten in their last four visits), they haven't secured a Ligue 1 win there since 1997. The 'Vélodrome factor' on opening night, coupled with the absence of Quinten Timber for Strasbourg due to suspension, further strengthens Marseille's position.
